title: Project ReGAIN Ex-Ante Modeling Document
text:
RRG has partnered with the Philippine Eagle Foundation (PEF) to conduct Project ReGAIN throughout the ancestral domain of the Obu-Manuvu on Mindano Island, Philippines. RRG and PEF have partnered to plant 4500 hectares.
In total, RRG estimates project activities can sequester ~ 1,170,659 Mg Co2e by the year 2064.

title: Project ReGAIN Ex-Ante Modeling Document
text:
Project Emissions
RRG and PEF will need to collaborate to conduct a cradle-to-grave life cycle assessment (LCA) to calculate emissions for project activities in three main pools - embodied, transportation and energy use. RRG and PEF have not conducted this analysis yet, and will employ a 20% discount rate.


Code
#helper for later
discount <- function(metric, scale) {
  mass <- metric * scale
  return(mass)
}

emissions <- 0.2



Leakge
RRG understands that Isometric performs the leakage analysis and that leakage will be quantified at the first verification event. RRG and PEF have worked with the Obu-Manuvu to ensure that local farmers are not displaced and their productivity is not impacted from project activities. PEF and the OM will ultimately sign agreements to ensure this. Furthermore, PEF aims to prioritize planting barren, degraded land and will not plant within agricultural zones. Because of this, as well as Isometric feedback, RRG will currently assume 0% leakage.
For now, RRG has highlighted the agricultural areas within the project zone.
Link to agricultural map


Code
leak <- 0 




Uncertainty
RRG aims to further address uncertainty in deeper analysis, but for now RRG will utilize a blanket 10% uncertainty rate. In practice, RRG takes 10% of the total Co2e removals per year.


Code
unc <- 0.1




Counterfactual
Isometric is in charge of quantifying the dynamic performance benchmark and counterfactual. The PB will most likely sway our estimates of MgC/ha. For now, RRG utilizes a 5% counterfactual.


Code
pb <- 0.05

title: Project ReGAIN Ex-Ante Modeling Document
text:
Net Carbon Removals
Per equation 13 of the agroforestry protocol, net CO2e removals are quantified as:
\[
CO2e Removal (t) = CO2e Stored (t) - CO2e Counterfactual (t) - CO2e Emissions    
\]
where:

\(t\) = time

\(CO2e Removal\) = total net CO2e removal, in Mg CO2e

\(CO2e Stored\) = total CO2e stored in both biomass pools, in Mg CO2e

\(CO2e Counterfactual\) = total counterfactual CO2 removed from the atmosphere and stored as organic carbon in living trees in the absence of Project activities, in Mg CO2e

\(CO2e Emissions\) = total GHG emissions (leakage + LCA), in Mg CO2e



Code
mega2 <- mega |>
  mutate(NetRemovals = ((TotalRemovals) - discount(TotalRemovals, pb) - discount(TotalRemovals, unc)  - (discount(TotalRemovals, leak) + discount(TotalRemovals, emissions)))) 

mega2$RemovalRate <- c(mega2$NetRemovals[1], diff(mega2$NetRemovals))

p1 <- mega2 |>
  ggplot(aes(x=Year, y = NetRemovals)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Modeled Net C02e Accumulation for Project ReGAIN", color = "", y = "Net Mg C02e", x="Year") +
  geom_text(aes(x = 2057, y = 730000, label = paste("Total Removals:\n", format(mega2$NetRemovals[41],
                                                                                big.mark = ",", nsmall = 2), 
                                                    "Mg Co2e")),size=4) +
  scale_y_continuous(label = comma)

p2 <- mega2 |>
  ggplot(aes(x=Year, y=RemovalRate)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Annual Removal Rate for Project ReGAIN", y = "Annual Mg C02e Removals", x="Year")+
  scale_y_continuous(label = comma)
 

p1 + p2









In total, RRG currently estimates that by year 40, net CO2e removals will be ~1,170,659 Mg CO2e.
